required_corrections: Restrict cover conclusion to energy of pulled-back harmonic map and associated eigenpair; lower eigenmodes of pullback metric uncontrolled.

accepted_main_result: For smooth positive b-periodic f(y) with max f <= integral_0^b f, the full first strictly positive Dirac eigenvalue is 2*pi/integral_0^b f, and its normalized value is at least the flat value.
